description: Tracks, via alf_after_step state, how many times each executed action returned an observation starting with 'Nothing happens'. In alf_before_step, warns about and discourages (via the discourage field) any action that has returned 'Nothing happens' 2 or more times, using only the episode's own action/observation stream. Threshold of 2 avoids penalizing actions that fail once due to positioning but would succeed later.
header: Discourages actions that repeatedly returned 'Nothing happens'.
